messages:
zoe: Morning micro-shout: huge merci to @tess and @omar for rescuing the demo table and the espresso machine this AM. Saved the whole walkthrough. :sparkling_heart:

tess: omg it was the one time i had gloves lol. @omar spotted the loose sensor in the grinder. team effort.

omar: remote high-five to @sam who brought duct tape and optimism. also thanks @lucy for covering the first 3 slides when i got delayed.

sam: duct tape and optimism: the unofficial Redwood stack. :package:

people-ops-bot: Quick poll: "Treats for the demo rescue crew?" :white_check_mark: Snacks / :gift: Vouchers / :coffee: Coffee delivery — react with an emoji.

lucy: :coffee: please, coffee for the late risers. also shoutout to @zoe for keeping the client on camera while we fixed things.

i an: +1 on vouchers for remote folks. and shoutout to @mika for the calm walkthrough notes. super clear.

mika: Thanks! I just pasted the tiny postmortem in the #incidents channel. Also - tiny idea - add a one-line "thanks" to the demo PR so contributors appear in the weekly digest.

dev-bot: Deploy note: fixed coffee-sensor handler rolled at 06:12 — logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/ci/coffee-3421

zoe: Love these suggestions. i'll compile a 1-line shoutout list and ping People Ops to send vouchers for remote folks and a snack box to the office crew. paste 1-line kudos here if you want included (gifs allowed). :tada:

tess: Tess -> Omar (grinder fix), Sam (duct tape), Zoe (client yoga), Mika (notes) :clap:

omar: Omar -> Tess (surgical glove heroics), Lucy (slide cover), Ian (voucher idea)

sam: Sam -> Tess + Omar for being the unsung maintenance squad. Also thanks to People Ops for the snack budget.

people-ops-bot: Noted. Creating voucher form and scheduling a small snack drop for Friday. Anonymity option available via DM to @people-ops.

zoe: Thats it — morning merci thread closed. If anyone wants to add micro-kudos for the weekly micro-newsletter, drop them by EOD. :sunrise_over_mountains:
